newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Wheat: Net sales of 82,900 metric tons (MT)--a marketing-year low--were off 64 percent from the previous week and 77 percent below the 4-week average. Increases reported for Italy (23,000 MT), Japan (22,900 MT), Algeria (18,300 MT), Ecuador (16,200 MT), and the Netherlands (15,800 MT) were partly offset by decreases for Turkey (28,500 MT) and unknown destinations (27,700 MT).

Exports of 569,500 MT were 23 percent above the week earlier and 18 percent more than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (116,900 MT), Pakistan (110,000 MT), the Philippines (102,500 MT), South Korea (32,900 MT), and Yemen (31,500 MT).
